appDesc.message: Modify HTTP request and response headers. Unlimited profiles, domain and tab group filters, 7 languages. Free and open source.
appDesc.description: Extension description shown in the store listing and chrome://extensions.

appName.message: Header Editor Pro – Modify HTTP Headers
appName.description: Extension name shown in the stores and in the browser.

toolbarPin.description: Tooltip on the pin button while the popup still closes automatically.

toolbarUnpin.description: Tooltip on the pin button while the popup is pinned open.

toolbarLanguage.description: Tooltip on the language selector button.

languageAuto.description: Language menu entry meaning 'follow the browser's language'. Keep it short — it sits beside a flag.

toolbarDescriptionPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the profile description field when it is empty.

menuCannotDeleteDefault.description: Replaces the delete entry when the default profile is selected.

modalModeNew.description: Import mode label. Quoted verbatim by errProfileListImport and errCannotReplaceMultiple — keep the three consistent.

colorPickerBackground.description: Tab label, uppercase in English. Two tabs share one row — keep it short.

colorPickerText.description: Tab label, uppercase in English. Two tabs share one row — keep it short.

headerAppendMode.description: Tooltip on the 'A' toggle that switches a header from set to append.

headerNoteAdd.description: Tooltip on the per-header note button when the header has no note yet (with a note, the tooltip is the note itself).

headerNotePlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the free-text note area shown below a header row.

headerCopyToProfile.description: Tooltip on the per-header copy button.

headerCopiedToast.description: Toast after copying a header. $1 = destination profile name, user-supplied.

filtersDomainsTooltip.message: Limit this profile to these domains

filtersDomainsPlaceholder.description: Example domains. Keep them as-is — they are not real names to translate.

filtersDomainsIgnored.description: $1 = comma-separated list of the entries that were dropped.

filtersTabGroupTooltip.message: Limit this profile to a tab group

filtersTabGroupUnnamed.description: Stands in for a Chrome tab group the user never titled.

filtersTabGroupNotOpen.description: Suffix on a saved tab group that no longer exists. Keep the leading space.

profileDefaultName.description: Name of the profile that ships with the extension. Stored as data on creation.

profileNewName.description: Name given to a newly created profile. $1 = a counter. Stored as data.

profileDeleteConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete "$1"? This action cannot be undone.

profileThisProfile.description: Stands in for the name in profileDeleteConfirm when it is missing.

infoAuthor.description: Only the word 'Author' translates — CharlyBrown is a person's handle.

infoVersion.description: $1 = version number from the manifest, e.g. 2.5.3.

welcomeTitle.description: First-install tooltip. 'Header Editor Pro' is the brand name — do not translate it.

welcomeSubtitle.message: Create unlimited profiles and modify HTTP headers easily

validReadyToCopyProfiles.description: $1 = how many profiles. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

validJsonProfiles.description: $1 = how many profiles. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

validJsonHeaders.description: $1 = how many headers. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

validImportFailed.description: $1 = the underlying error text, already translated when it is ours.

errHeaderMissingName.description: $1 = position of the header in the imported list, starting at 1. Not a count.

errInvalidJsonFormat.message: Invalid JSON format. Expected array of headers or profiles object.

errProfileListImport.message: This file holds a list of profiles. Use "Create new profile" mode to import it.
errProfileListImport.description: The quoted text is the modalModeNew label — keep both in step.

errCannotReplaceMultiple.message: Cannot replace current profile with multiple profiles. Use "Create new profile" mode instead.
errCannotReplaceMultiple.description: The quoted text is the modalModeNew label — keep both in step.

importUrlFiltersSkipped.message: URL filters were not converted. Affected profiles: $1. Recreate them with this extension’s domain filters if needed.
importUrlFiltersSkipped.description: $1 = how many profiles were affected. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

importedProfileName.description: Name for a profile created by an import. $1 = a counter. Stored as data.

importedProfileDescription.description: Description stored on a profile created by importing a profile list.

exportFilenameFallback.description: Filename stem used when a profile name keeps no characters a filename can use (e.g. it is all CJK). Lowercase ASCII only, no spaces.

importedFromJson.message: Imported from JSON - click to edit
importedFromJson.description: Description stored on a profile imported from a JSON file.

validJsonRequestly.description: $1 = how many Requestly rules the file holds. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

errRequestlyReplace.message: This is a Requestly export, which can create several profiles. Use "Create new profile" mode to import it.
errRequestlyReplace.description: The quoted text is the modalModeNew label — keep both in step.

importRequestlyDone.message: Imported from Requestly — redirects: $1, profiles created: $2.
importRequestlyDone.description: First line of the Requestly import summary. $1 = redirects imported, $2 = profiles created. Phrased to avoid plural forms.

importRequestlyNothing.message: Nothing was imported: no redirect in this Requestly file can be converted. No profile was created.
importRequestlyNothing.description: Requestly import summary when no rule could be converted.

importRequestlySkipped.description: Heading of the list of Requestly rules left out. $1 = how many entries.

importRequestlyMore.description: Last line when the left-out list is truncated. $1 = how many were not listed.

requestlyUnnamedRule.description: Shown instead of the name of a Requestly rule that has none.

requestlyProfileName.description: Name of the profile holding Requestly rules that belong to no group. Stored as data.

requestlySkipNotRedirect.description: Why a Requestly rule was left out: it modifies headers, mocks a response, etc.

requestlySkipHasFilters.message: uses filters (method, resource type, page…) that can't be converted
requestlySkipHasFilters.description: Why a Requestly rule was left out: its request filters would be lost, making it redirect more.

requestlySkipUnsupportedSource.message: source type not supported (path, or host with a regex)
requestlySkipUnsupportedSource.description: Why a Requestly rule was left out: its source condition has no equivalent here.

requestlySkipLocalDestination.message: redirects to a local file or mock
requestlySkipLocalDestination.description: Why a Requestly rule was left out: its destination only exists inside Requestly.

requestlySkipIncomplete.description: Why a Requestly rule was left out: it has an empty source or destination.

redirectPatternPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the redirect source field. Keep the example regex as is.

redirectTargetPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the redirect destination field. $1 is literal (a capture group), not a substitution.

redirectCors.message: Also allow cross-origin requests to the target (sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; doesn't work with credentials)
redirectCors.description: Tooltip on the CORS toggle of a redirect row.

redirectInvalidPattern.description: Tooltip on an invalid redirect pattern. $1 = the browser's reason.
